description: 한국철도공사_철도 용어해설 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. ‘한국철도공사철도 용어해설’ 데이터는 한국철도공사에서 제공하는 철도 용어 해설집으로, 여객, 물류, 시설, 전기, 차량, 운전 등 철도 전 분야에 걸친 전문 용어의 정의와 해설을. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 철도 용어, 용어 해설, 전문 용어, 표준화 노력, 분야별 용어 분화. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
